notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Gameplay Patch 1.1

Hello everyone,

It’s almost been a month since the launch of The Rangers in the South, and the support and feedback from the community have been incredibly valuable.

Based on this, I have gathered the best comments and suggestions to develop the first gameplay patch. This update addresses some "urgent" issues affecting the core game experience while also redefining some key mechanics.

What's New

• New Currency: Ranger Points
A new currency, "Ranger Points," has been added. These points can be used to purchase persistent upgrades, such as increased inventory space, permanent skill improvements, or starting with more rerolls.

• New Death Menu
Upon death, a new menu will be displayed, showing various character statistics: number of enemies defeated, gold obtained, duration of the run, and more. Based on these attributes, a final score will be calculated, which will translate into a certain amount of Ranger Points usable for the next character.

• Difficulty Menu
A new menu allows players to select difficulty levels when starting a new character. This system enables adjustments to hunger rate generation, potion disable options, and other factors. Increasing the difficulty will also boost the number of Ranger Points earned at the end of each run. To unlock new difficulty levels, players must defeat the Demon Lord.

• Skill Enhancements
All skills can now be upgraded via a new initial menu. Enhancements vary for each skill, from reducing cooldowns to making certain abilities bounce between enemies.

• Customization Options
A basic character customization option has been added.

I am very excited about this version as it addresses many of the most common and important player concerns.

I invite everyone to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/gYZxQFpR9M to share suggestions for future gameplay patches and report any bugs.

Don't forget to check the 2025 Roadmap! The next update will feature the Necromancer class and new boss mechanics. See you in the game!

notes.title: Pre-release and Endgame Anouncement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are incredibly excited and proud to announce the official release of The Rangers in the South on Thursday, January 9th. Only one week left!

It has been a long journey filled with dedication and effort, and we can't wait for you to experience it.

In addition to confirming that the game will be available in multiple languages from day one, we want to share some details about the endgame mechanics we've been refining over the past few days.

As you may already know, the game features roguelike mechanics, meaning each run or character will develop a unique combat strategy based on a selection of abilities. This ensures that, eventually—through luck or strategy—you might defeat the final boss of the game.

If you reach this point, congratulations! But this is where the real challenge begins.

Once you defeat the final boss, a Final Boss Counter will unlock. However, with each victory, all enemies will gain 10% more health and damage, progressively increasing the difficulty.

All this data will be compiled into a global leaderboard, showcasing the players who have defeated the final boss the most times. The player holding the world record will have their name proudly displayed on the game's main menu. (The leaderboard will also be available in the Steam community.)

To help you overcome these escalating challenges, we've added additional mechanics to aid your progress—but we won't spoil everything just yet!

We can't wait to see who will claim the title of First World Champion.

Additionally, we have many ideas for introducing new mechanics, abilities, and content. We're always open to hearing community suggestions, so don't hesitate to reach out if you have any ideas.

We hope you enjoy it!

Best regards,The Rangers in the South Team

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been over a month since we launched our demo, and we’ve received thousands of comments! Thank you so much for taking the time to try it out, share your feedback, and enjoy it!

Many of your comments have been extremely valuable, and we’ve been working hard to incorporate them into the game! For this reason, we want to let you know that we have updated our demo with a lot of the feedback we received from the community.

As you know, we are a really small team, so we haven’t been able to address all of your suggestions yet, but please know that we are taking them into account!

Remember, the game launches on January 9th, so we are still welcoming your feedback!

(You can now get the dog in the game)
Best regards to everyone,
Slat
